smarttrade.trade.cocoa_beans.lore: Seeds from imperial jungle carry aromatic power; twenty units buy one emerald inside the market of truth Knight King now.
smarttrade.trade.cocoa_beans.description: Allows the farmer to buy 20 cocoa beans for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.honeycomb.lore: Ten combs form golden treasure of alchemist bees, worthy of one emerald removed directly from very royal treasury forever.
smarttrade.trade.honeycomb.description: Allows the farmer to buy 10 honeycombs for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.spider_eye.lore: Fifteen eyes from spider beasts feed secret rituals; cleric pay one emerald under authorization of the Knight King today.
smarttrade.trade.spider_eye.description: Allows the cleric to buy 15 spider eyes for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.ender_pearl.lore: Three pearls taked from void dragons bend the space; cleric offer one emerald for this very big dimensional power forever.
smarttrade.trade.ender_pearl.description: Allows the cleric to buy 3 Ender pearls for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.redstone.lore: Twenty redstone dust make mechanical blood for royal artifacts; cleric reward this grand tribute with one emerald forever.
smarttrade.trade.redstone.description: Allows the cleric to buy 20 redstone dust for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.lapis_lazuli.lore: Twenty lapis have enough blue magic for enchant Excalibur; cleric pay one emerald for doing this sacred ritual imperial.
smarttrade.trade.lapis_lazuli.descriptio: Allows the cleric to buy 20 lapis lazuli for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.bone.lore: Twenty bones from defeated enemies prove glorious campaign; butcher give one emerald directly for hero of kingdom forever.
smarttrade.trade.bone.description: Allows the butcher to buy 20 bones for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.arrow.lore: Fifteen arrows supply crown archers for next war; fletcher pay one emerald to the most official royal supplier imperial.
smarttrade.trade.arrow.description: Allows the fletcher to buy 15 arrows for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.options.title: GLOBAL OPTIONS
smarttrade.options.subtitle: Select the global options you want to enable.
smarttrade.options.jade_reputation.lore: Diplomatic vision of king reveal trust, routines and curing of villager; no subject hide the loyalty away from crown now.
smarttrade.options.jade_reputation.descr: Shows three values for the observed villager in Jade: reputation toward the player, green with a + sign above 0, red below 0, and gray at 0; restocks completed that day in current/2 format; and Cured as Yes when that player's major_positive reputation is above 0. With ABSOLUTE PRESTIGE, reputation shows +150 while Cured uses the real data. Requires Jade.
smarttrade.options.maximum_reputation.lo: Name of Knight King cross village first; doors and prices bow down to absolute prestige from their legitimate sovereign.
smarttrade.options.maximum_reputation.de: Makes every reputation query from any villager return 150 for the player, affecting special prices for vanilla and CONTROL TRADE offers. For the mod's nine offers, the 0.05 multiplier reduces the cost by 7 items before demand and other modifiers, respecting the final minimum price of 1 item. Vanilla offers use their own multipliers. Real reputation data remains preserved.
smarttrade.options.soul_speed_nether.lor: Souls of Nether push only the step worthy of infernal kingdom; outside, their power recognize lands without authority now.
smarttrade.options.soul_speed_nether.des: Restricts Soul Speed's effects to the Nether. In other dimensions, living entities with any enchantment level receive a 1.0 speed factor on blocks in the minecraft:soul_speed_blocks tag. Ridden horses also receive this factor when their controlling passenger wears the enchantment. The check considers the block at the entity's position and the block below. In vanilla content, the tag contains exactly soul sand and soul soil; data packs and mods can expand it.
smarttrade.options.fixed_mushroom_height: Saplings and fungus obey king decree and get titanic proportions, building forest worthy of the legends from Excalibur now.

Standardizes forms cultivated from their small block: red and brown mushrooms on crimson or warped nylium use 5- and 4-block stems and occupy up to 6 and 5 layers with the cap; jungle, acacia, cherry, birch and oak saplings use a 6-block trunk; crimson and warped fungi on their matching nylium use a 6-block stem in 11 of 12 cases or 12 blocks in 1 of 12, occupying up to 7 or 13 layers. Preserves natural sapling growth, the 40% bone-meal chance for mushrooms and fungi, the 45% chance for saplings, and vanilla requirements. Does not alter forms generated with the world.
smarttrade.options.compact_horse_health_: Ten sovereign hearts is enough for represent all mount force, because Knight King not need counting more than this today.

Limits the health HUD for horses, donkeys, mules, zombie horses, and skeleton horses to one row of 10 hearts, filled proportionally to the mount's maximum health. Changes only the display; actual health, damage, and healing remain unchanged.
smarttrade.options.equestrian_hud.lore: Knight and mount share one bond decreted by destiny; their signs march together in front of eyes from the kingdom forever.
smarttrade.options.equestrian_hud.descri: Shows the player's food and the mount's health at the same time, also repositioning air bubbles to prevent overlaps. Keeps the experience bar and level visible while the mount is not jumping; holding the jump key or starting to charge displays the jump bar. (GPL)
smarttrade.options.automatic_door_closin: Doors and gates of kingdom watch their own passing, closing after every entrance for protect castle from invaders forever.

Closes wooden doors and fence gates 5 seconds (100 ticks) after the player opens them directly in a singleplayer world. Before closing, checks whether the position still contains the same type of open block; if it is closed, absent, or has been changed to another block, nothing happens. After closing, checks again in 0.5 seconds and, if the block is still open, makes only one extra attempt. Opening it again restarts the countdown.
smarttrade.options.disable_chat_history_: Knight King never search old commands with peasant arrows; his supreme memory know every order without any helping today.
Prevents the up and down arrow keys from navigating through previous messages and commands on the chat screen. The history continues to be stored normally.
smarttrade.options.compact_item_counts.l: Tiny runes count gigantic reserves without hiding relics; sovereign understand entire arsenal with only one royal looking.
smarttrade.options.compact_item_counts.d: Replaces item stack count numbers with a compact 3x5 font inspired by Create's interface, with a dark outline to remain readable over light and dark backgrounds. Changes only the display; the actual item quantities remain unchanged. (GPL)
Royal backpack defy laws of space, gathering provisions and relics in infinite arsenal for campaigns without no ending now.

Changes the maximum stack size of soups except Suspicious Stews, Ender pearls, cakes, and items in the c:eggs tag to 64; saddles, potions, harnesses, boats, beds, enchanted books, music discs, and items in the c:buckets tag to 16. Recognizes the c:foods/soup, c:potions, minecraft:harnesses, minecraft:boats, minecraft:beds, c:music_discs, c:eggs, and c:buckets tags, including items added to them by data packs and mods. Designed for singleplayer worlds; on external servers, the server controls the actual limits.
smarttrade.options.random_experience_orb: Every defeated experience choose heraldic color; orbs celebrate with light the glorious campaigns from Knight King today.
Assigns each experience orb a stable color, randomly chosen from #FFBF0B, #FB5607, #FF006E, and #3A86FF, with 180/255 opacity. The color remains the same throughout the orb's existence.
smarttrade.options.compact_information_o: Tactical oracle reveal time, direction, memory and territory in one look, guiding every infallible Knight King decision.

Toggles an uppercase overlay in the top-left corner with one press of TAB, containing real time and the Minecraft world clock in 12-hour format, used/maximum memory and percentage, current/limited FPS, integer coordinates of the block occupied by the player, direction with axis, and biome. The memory line is green through 75% and red from 76%. Direct TAB detection is independent of configured controls. Keeps the player list and the vanilla debug screen unchanged.
smarttrade.options.compact_game_menus.lo: Every button receive position by imperial decree; ordered paths guide Knight King without distractions into his destiny.
smarttrade.options.compact_game_menus.de: Organizes the out-of-game and in-game menus with the first button in one 200 px row and the remaining buttons in two 98 px columns separated by 4 px. Out of game: Player; Players and Mods; Friends and Realms; Options and Quit. In game: Play; Friends and Mods; LAN and Statistics; Options and Save (Quit). Removes icons from both menus and the version text in the lower-left corner of the title screen; Language and Accessibility remain in vanilla options, while Advancements, Report, Feedback, and Report bug are placed inside Options during the game.
smarttrade.options.sovereign_shift.lore: By crown decree, the bed bend kingdom clock: Knight King trade sun for moon and moon for sun in one sovereign jumping forever.
smarttrade.options.sovereign_shift.descr: Transforms the bed into a shift exchange in the Overworld. While the sky is not yet dark, allows sleeping and advances the clock to vanilla's beginning-of-night marker, at 13000 ticks. During the hours when Minecraft normally allows sleep, fully preserves vanilla behavior and wakes at the sleep-specific marker, at 0 tick. Keeps the vanilla requirements for distance, free space, safety from monsters, percentage of sleeping players, and the time advancement gamerule.
smarttrade.options.sovereign_seal.lore: Crown engrave names in exposed relics; every name tag make the frame a baptism altar worthy for the supreme Knight King.
smarttrade.options.sovereign_seal.descri: Allows use name tags for rename the item displayed in an item frame. Right-click applies the name. This option also make possible put Spears in frames, just sneak and click one empty frame.
smarttrade.options.insane_difficulty.lor: World unite dragons, armies and impossible dangers in absolute challenge, finally worthy of the truth Knight King forever.
smarttrade.options.insane_difficulty.des: Adds Insane to the difficulties without choosing it automatically and removes the world lock. Keeps the Hard rules, but raises damage taken by player to 200% and equine mounts to 150%, while reducing spear damage from every source by 30%; zombies with iron equipment and spiders with effects get up to 30% chance, and raids reach 12 waves. In natural spawning, multiplies Witches weight by 8 and Endermen by 3. Spiders and baby zombies start hitting the equine mount instead of rider. Horses, donkeys, mules, zombie horses, and skeleton horses receive 50 ticks of immunity (2.5 seconds) after one hit. On death, player immediately loses all content from one occupied slot randomly chosen between armor and offhand, plus another occupied slot randomly chosen in hotbar.
